import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import execution_receipt as R, execution_spec as S
from execute_provider import CLAUDE_DISALLOWED_TOOLS, provider_contract
assert S.CURRENT_PROVIDER_CONTRACT == 9 and 9 in S.PROVIDER_CONTRACTS_V3
spec = {"provider": "claude", "model": "opus", "effort": "high", "speed": "unknown", "repo": "/tmp/r", "prompt": "go", "write_scope": []}
for role in ("worker", "brain"):
    argv, _ = provider_contract({**spec, "role": role, "provider_contract_version": 9})
    assert "--allowedTools" not in argv, argv
    assert "--strict-mcp-config" in argv and "--mcp-config" not in argv, argv
    assert argv[argv.index("--permission-mode") + 1] == "bypassPermissions", argv
    assert argv[argv.index("--add-dir") + 1] == "/tmp/r", argv
    assert argv[argv.index("--disallowedTools") + 1] == CLAUDE_DISALLOWED_TOOLS, argv
    assert argv.index("go") < argv.index("--disallowedTools"), argv
legacy, _ = provider_contract({**spec, "role": "worker", "provider_contract_version": 8})
assert "--allowedTools" in legacy and "bypassPermissions" not in legacy, legacy
assert all(tok in CLAUDE_DISALLOWED_TOOLS for tok in ("Bash(*rm -rf *)", "Bash(*git*push*)", "Bash(*git*reset*--hard*)", "Edit(~/.claude/**)", "Write(.git/config)"))
assert not R.in_scope("scripts/json.py", ["scripts/**"]) and not R.in_scope(".gitignore", [".gitignore"])
print("ok")

import os, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
from execute_provider import provider_contract
argv_cx, _ = provider_contract({"provider": "codex", "model": "gpt-6-luna", "effort": "medium", "speed": "unknown", "repo": "/tmp/r", "prompt": "go", "write_scope": [], "role": "worker", "provider_contract_version": 9})
assert argv_cx[argv_cx.index("-s") + 1] == "workspace-write", argv_cx
c_vals = [argv_cx[i + 1] for i, tok in enumerate(argv_cx[:-1]) if tok == "-c"]
for item in ("sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true", "web_search=\"live\"", "mcp_servers.cua_repl={command=\"true\",enabled=false}", "mcp_servers.node_repl={command=\"true\",enabled=false}"):
    assert item in c_vals, (item, c_vals)
env = {**os.environ, "PATH": "/opt/homebrew/bin:" + os.environ.get("PATH", "")}
out = subprocess.check_output(["codex", *[x for v in c_vals for x in ("-c", v)], "mcp", "list"], text=True, env=env)
rows = {line.split()[0]: line.split()[-2] for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith("Name ")}
assert rows.get("cua_repl") == "disabled" and rows.get("node_repl") == "disabled", rows
print("ok")

import os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import probe_seat as P
from execute_provider import provider_contract
limiting = {"--allowedTools", "--tools", "--restricted", "--sandbox", "--disable-slash-commands", "--plan", "--mode"}
for prov, mod, eff, spd in (("agent", "composer-2.5", "medium", "standard"), ("agy", "gemini-3.8-flash-medium", "medium", "unknown")):
    a, _ = provider_contract({"provider": prov, "model": mod, "effort": eff, "speed": spd, "repo": "/tmp/r", "prompt": "go", "write_scope": [], "role": "worker", "provider_contract_version": 9})
    assert not (limiting & set(a)), (prov, a)
env = {**os.environ, "PATH": "/opt/homebrew/bin:" + os.environ.get("PATH", "")}
cap = pathlib.Path("docs/missions/capabilities")
for cli in ("claude", "codex", "cursor-agent", "agy"):
    base_flags = P.recorded_flags(cli, cap)
    assert len(base_flags) >= 5, cli
    live_flags = P.help_flags(subprocess.check_output([cli, "--help"], text=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env))
    assert len(live_flags) >= 5, cli
    assert P.new_help_flags([*base_flags, "--brand-new-flag"], base_flags) == ["--brand-new-flag"], cli
print("ok")
